name: Illusionist (幻术师)
author: airmongsity
description: A standalone character with 90+ cards built around three linked systems: store Exhausted cards in Mirror Images for future execution, manipulate enemy intents, and layer or revert Transmutes. Includes custom relics, potions, Frozen card afflictions, and Ancient upgrades. Requires RitsuLib. English & 简体中文.
